corrected_readiness_criterion: Re-file this item's NOT-READY condition as: 'n>=20 real fills for risky-1 (non-FULL_SEND) + risky-3 COMBINED, each fill's logged `equity` field < $2,000 at decision time' -- not a raw total-fill count. Given both arms started at $5,000 and neither has approached $2,000 (no daily-loss kill-switch trip found for either in the post-08-01 window), this gate is unlikely to become scoreable without a sustained, severe drawdown. Downgraded from 'pending, evidence accruing' to 'pending, structurally dormant -- re-check only if either arm's equity crosses below $2,000' so future fires stop re-reading this as an active in-progress evidence-collection item.
generalizable_lesson: A prereg's 'n>=N fills' sample-floor gate must be scoped to the SPECIFIC sub-population the code change can actually affect (here: an equity bracket), not the account's/arm's total fill count -- otherwise a structurally-unreachable change can sit 'ready to evaluate' indefinitely while silently accruing zero real evidence, and a naive scoring pass would misattribute a DIFFERENT prereg's (already-adjudicated) fills to this one. Filed to _lesson-inbox as the generalizable instance.
